caption: The drawing depicts a tombstone rendered in pencil or a similar monochrome medium on a plain, light-colored background. The tombstone is rectangular with a slightly rounded top. Near the top, there is a rectangular inset relief showing two male figures; one figure stands beneath two leafy trees while the other, standing to the right, appears to be aiming a gun at the first figure. Below this scene, the tombstone has inscribed text in capital and cursive letters: "THOMAS PAGE, ASSASSINATED By the hand of J. TIBBETTS. Jan. 1, 1866; Aged 48 years." The entirety of the image is executed in shades of gray with fine shading, giving a three-dimensional appearance to the tombstone and its inscribed and relief details. The background is otherwise empty, and the artist's name, “robert clark,” is faintly visible in small letters near the lower left edge of the drawing.
title: Tombstone
